import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
rows=[]
for service in ("postgres","redis","minio"):
    name="ai-trading-research-"+service+"-1"
    data=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker","inspect","--format",'{ "id":{{json .Id}}, "started":{{json .State.StartedAt}}, "mounts":{{json .Mounts}} }',name],text=True))
    rows.append({"service":service,"state":data})
Path(".cache/phase2/data-services-before.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
path=Path(".cache/phase2/pre-migration.dump")
with path.open("xb") as output:
    os.chmod(path,0o600)
    result=subprocess.run(["docker","compose","exec","-T","postgres","pg_dump","-U","research","-d","research","--format=custom"],stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
if result.returncode: raise RuntimeError("Private database backup failed; migration not authorized to proceed without backup")
print("Private backup bytes:",path.stat().st_size,"SHA256:",hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print("Data service IDs/start times/mounts captured without secrets.")
